printer: Stratasys J850, High Quality (14 um), glossy; clear slot = Vero UltraClear
phase_function: g = 0 with reduced scattering sigma_s' = sigma_s (1 - g); equivalent in the diffusive regime and cheaper for volpath than a forward-peaked phase
ior_note: One IOR for every resin. Cured Vero resins differ by ~0.01, which reflects < 0.01 % at normal incidence, but every IOR step becomes an internal dielectric surface in prepare_mitsuba_scene (path depth, noise, dark rims). A single IOR removes all internal interfaces.
source: Physical priors from .devdocs/episodes/viewer_feedback_improve/p1/plan.md, then tuned by eye+numbers against batch1 phone photos (p1 step 7, contact_sheet.py regions, white-paper normalised). No measured Vero coefficients (Elek et al. 2017 / Brunton et al. 2018 not consulted). Not calibration data.

resins.note: slightly more blue scattering (Rayleigh-like tint of thin white-in-clear); neutral absorption
effectively opaque; 12000 keeps agate darks, amber chroma is limited mostly by yellow
Vero UltraClear (not VeroClear): barely tinted; fur margin/hair were too yellow at 5/8/15
red-leaning magenta: absorbs green and much of blue, so 27-38 % magenta + white reads salmon/coral, not pink-violet
strong blue absorption, some green: amber host reads orange-olive
